name: Roland XV-5050
description: Roland XV-5050 synthesizer module: the setup and system blocks, the temporary performance (common, its three MFX, chorus, reverb, MIDI, and the Part block of each of its 16 parts), and Part 1's temporary patch and rhythm set, from the MIDI Implementation chapter of the owner's manual.

sources.title: XV-5050 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, October 4, 2001)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from XV-5050_OM.pdf (sha256 81049a25488a01d2c2c0202e5a9dca6072e4fedcd3f4cf83edacd3d9421556a9). Model ID 00 10, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Performance parts are filed as "Part n" (id part<n>.*), Part 1's patch as "Part 1 · Patch · …" (part1.patch.*) and its rhythm set as "Part 1 · Rhythm Set · …" (part1.rhythm.*); the performance's own blocks as "Performance · …" and its MIDI blocks by channel.

LFO1 Wave Form and LFO2 Wave Form (0-10) print their labels as "SIN, TRI, SAW-UP, SAW-DW, SQR, RND, BEND-UP, BEND-DW, TRP, S&H" with "CHS" alone on the next line and no comma before it (the XV-5080's p297; every XV manual sets it so): ten labels for eleven values, so both stay numbers with the manual's line as their description rather than labels that would be off by one.
Rows the manual tags for other models (`<XV-5080>`, `<XV-3080/5080>`, the XV-2020's `<*>`) keep the tag in their name and choice labels, where a reader sees it, and lose it in their ids.
Identity: family code 10 01 and family number 02 02 (p161), its own among the XV series as printed: the XV-5080, XV-3080 and XV-88 print 00 00, the XV-2020 00 03.

The performance's three MFX are "Performance · MFXA", "· MFXB" and "· MFXC" (ids performance.mfxA.* …), each the Performance Common MFX table (p162-163). Performance Common prints MFXB Source and MFXC Source <*>, ignored when received (p163), so they are not laid out; Part Output MFX Select offers MFXA-MFXC.
Each part's scale tune is in its Performance Part block (Part Scale Tune for C … B), and the patch-mode one in System Common; there is no System Part block.

Presets list Patches (Bank Select MSB 87: User 00, Preset A-H 64-71) and Rhythm Sets (MSB 86: User 00, Preset A-H 64-71), p30-31, recalled on the profile's channel. Not listed: Performances (MSB 85: User 00, Preset A/B 64/65), the General MIDI 2 sounds (MSB 121/120) and the SRX boards (MSB 92/93).

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.patch, part1.patch.mfx, part1.patch.chorus, part1.patch.reverb, part1.patch.tmt, part1.patch.tone1, part1.patch.tone2, part1.patch.tone3, part1.patch.tone4, part1.rhythm, part1.rhythm.mfx, part1.rhythm.chorus, part1.rhythm.reverb, part1.rhythm.key35, part1.rhythm.key36, part1.rhythm.key37, part1.rhythm.key38, part1.rhythm.key39, part1.rhythm.key40, part1.rhythm.key41, part1.rhythm.key42, part1.rhythm.key43, part1.rhythm.key44, part1.rhythm.key45, part1.rhythm.key46, part1.rhythm.key47, part1.rhythm.key48, part1.rhythm.key49, part1.rhythm.key50, part1.rhythm.key51, part1.rhythm.key52, part1.rhythm.key53, part1.rhythm.key54, part1.rhythm.key55, part1.rhythm.key56, part1.rhythm.key57, part1.rhythm.key58, part1.rhythm.key59, part1.rhythm.key60, part1.rhythm.key61, part1.rhythm.key62, part1.rhythm.key63, part1.rhythm.key64, part1.rhythm.key65, part1.rhythm.key66, part1.rhythm.key67, part1.rhythm.key68, part1.rhythm.key69, part1.rhythm.key70, part1.rhythm.key71, part1.rhythm.key72, part1.rhythm.key73, part1.rhythm.key74, part1.rhythm.key75, part1.rhythm.key76, part1.rhythm.key77, part1.rhythm.key78, part1.rhythm.key79, part1.rhythm.key80, part1.rhythm.key81.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the instrument receives and transmits as Control Change (received p154-157, transmitted p160-161) is not mapped yet
coverage.parts: the Temporary Performance's Part block for every part the map addresses (of 1-16); the temporary patch and rhythm set of Part 1 only. Parts 2-16's are not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Performance Mode Part n) is at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) x 00 20 00 00 (… 14 60 00 00 for Part 16), its patch at +00 00 00 and its rhythm set at +10 00 00, the same blocks as Part 1's
coverage.patchMode: not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Patch Mode), the patch or rhythm set played in Patch mode, at 1F 00 00 00 (patch) and 1F 10 00 00 (rhythm set): the same blocks as Part 1's at another base
coverage.toneTypes: Part 1 plays a patch or a rhythm set; both are laid out (patch at 11 00 00 00, rhythm set at 11 10 00 00) and neither is read at startup, since a request the instrument cannot answer gets no reply and the engine's startup read stops at the first request that is not answered
coverage.rhythmKeys: rhythm tones for keys 35-81 (the General MIDI percussion keys) that the map addresses; Rhythm Tone (Key # k) is at the rhythm set's base + 00 10 00 + (k-21) x 00 02 00, so for Part 1 keys 21-34 are at 11 10 10 00-11 10 2A 00 and keys 82-108 at 11 11 0A 00-11 11 3E 00; all eighty-eight would be over twelve thousand parameters on their own
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.notModelled: User Performances (20 00 00 00), User Patches (30 00 00 00) and User Rhythm Sets (40 00 00 00): memories, not the edit buffer
